acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Two lawyers dive into the details of what they’ve witnessed behind the scenes in different parts of the immigration system.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Former ICE attorney Ryan Schwank explains the chaos and dysfunction he observed at an ICE training academy, which led him to whistleblow to Congress two weeks ago.
acts.credits: By Nadia Reiman; Edited by Laura Starecheski
acts.title: I Got the Memo

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A federal judge orders the government to immediately release a bunch of people from detention. Days pass, and the government doesn’t comply. So the judge calls a hearing to figure out what’s going on. The lawyer's response is not what he or anybody expected.
acts.title: Don’t Trust the Process
